name: fmp_historical_price
description:
Daily end-of-day prices for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/historical-price-eod/full): open, high, low, close, volume and change per date.
Returns {symbol, prices}: prices is FMP's list of daily records (with data_points added when FMP wraps them in a historical list).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), from_date (YYYY-MM-DD), to_date (YYYY-MM-DD); without dates FMP's default range applies.
For the latest quote use fmp_stock_quote; for indexes, forex, crypto and commodities use fmp_index_historical, fmp_forex_historical, fmp_crypto_historical, fmp_commodity_historical.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "from_date": "2025-01-01", "to_date": "2025-03-31"}
